content: rust-embed 8.12.0 (2026-07-08, actively maintained, 45.7M downloads; note 8.10.0 yanked) vs include_dir 0.7.4 (2024-06-17, stale, 63.7M downloads). rust-embed wins: derive macro, dev-mode disk reads, release embeds, optional compression. For a single-HTML frontend, stdlib include_str!/include_bytes! is enough.
